conventions.replaces: This file replaces the stale SH-12 contracts.
conventions.basePath: /api. This is the existing SchoolHub convention, not /api/v1. Route files are src/app/api/**/route.ts. (FR-28)
conventions.handlerPipeline: withHandler → requireUser / requireRole, or requireSafeguardingLead for safeguarding routes → parseQuery / parseBody with schemas from src/lib/validators/messaging.ts → one service call in src/server/messaging/* → ok(data) / ok(data, {status:201}) / paginated(data, meta). (NFR-6)

envelopes.list: { data: T[], meta: { page, pageSize, total } } for page-based lists. Pagination comes from parsePagination: default page size 20, max 100.

errorPolicy: If the caller is not a participant, or has left (leftAt is set), the API returns 404 NOT_FOUND. A conversation cuid is never treated as authorisation. (NFR-1)
A contact-rule violation on create returns 403 FORBIDDEN, and nothing is written. (FR-6)
A send after the relationship has ended returns 403 FORBIDDEN with details.reason='RELATIONSHIP_ENDED'. (FR-7)

An edit or delete by someone other than the sender, more than 15 minutes after sending, or on an already-deleted message returns 403 FORBIDDEN. details.reason is 'NOT_SENDER', 'EDIT_WINDOW_EXPIRED' or 'ALREADY_DELETED'. (FR-15)
A rate-limit hit returns 429 RATE_LIMITED with details.retryAfterMs. (NFR-4)
A caller who is not an ADMIN with isSafeguardingLead=true (read from the database) gets 403 FORBIDDEN on /api/safeguarding/*. (FR-23, NFR-1)
conventions.ids: All ids are cuid strings. All timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC strings. The client renders them in the school timezone. (NFR-6)

Attachment.name: string
Attachment.url: string (/api/files/:id, gated by the 'message' file context, FR-27)

MessageDTO.canEdit: boolean (isOwn, not deleted, and now - createdAt ≤ 15 min)

ConversationListItem.subject: string|null
ConversationListItem.preview: string|null ('<first name>: <body ≤80>' or 'This message was deleted')

ConversationDetail.subject: string|null
ConversationDetail.canLeave: boolean (false when ≤2 participants, or when the caller is the creator and involvesStudent is true, FR-14)

ContactGroup.label: string, e.g. 'My teachers', 'My child's teachers (Sam)', 'Students in MATH-7A', 'Parents of students in MATH-7A', 'Homeroom 7A', 'Staff', 'School office'

components.SafeguardingMessageDTO: MessageDTO with body always present (including deleted content), plus deletedAt: string|null and revisions: { body: string, createdAt: string }[] (NFR-3)

endpoints.description: Returns the caller's conversations that they have not left, sorted by lastMessageAt desc. The Inbox tab sends archived=false (the default) and the Archived tab sends archived=true. q matches participant name or subject. Polled every 30 s.

Creates a conversation, adding the caller as a participant automatically, together with its first message. The request must pass validateNewConversation: 2–25 participants including the caller, canMessage(creator, p) for every participant, and a TEACHER or ADMIN in any group that contains a STUDENT. involvesStudent is computed here. The send side effects of POST .../messages also apply.

body.subject: string? ≤120
body.fileIds: cuid[]? ≤5 (owned by the caller, unattached, context 'message')

errors: 403 FORBIDDEN (contact rules, group without staff, more than 25 participants; nothing is created)

endpoints.description: Returns the conversation header, the participants, the caller's state, canSend and canLeave.

Keyset-paginated messages. Without a cursor it returns the latest page. 'before' loads older messages for the upward infinite scroll. 'after' (plus an optional 'since') is the 5-second poll, which returns new messages plus messages edited or deleted since the given time. A poll with nothing new returns empty arrays and is designed to respond in under 100 ms using @@index([conversationId, createdAt]).

data.changed: MessageDTO[] (only when after+since is sent; messages with createdAt ≤ cursor and updatedAt > since)
data.hasMore: boolean (older messages exist; only in initial and 'before' mode)

errors: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (before and after both sent, or since without after)
404 NOT_FOUND (not a participant, or the cursor id is not in this conversation)

endpoints.description: Sends a message. Order: rate limit, participation, canSendIn (staff can always send; a non-staff sender needs a live relationship with at least one staff participant who has not left), attachment ownership, then a transaction that inserts the message, links the files, bumps lastMessageAt, sets the sender's lastReadAt and clears archivedAt for the other participants. After commit, onMessageSent runs for each other participant who has not muted or left: it deletes their older unread message.received row, notifies in-app and upserts PendingMessageEmail (dueAt = now + 10 min, create-only).
endpoints.auth: participant who has not left; rateLimit('msg:'+uid, 30, 60_000)

endpoints.description: Sets the caller's lastReadAt to now, marks the caller's unread message.received notification for this conversation as read, and deletes the caller's PendingMessageEmail row for it.
Mutes or unmutes the conversation for the caller only. Muted participants get no message.received notification and no email.
Archives or unarchives the conversation for the caller only. A new message from someone else unarchives it.

Sets leftAt for the caller. After that the caller is treated as a non-participant (404, and no attachment access). Leaving is refused for conversations with 2 or fewer participants, and for the creator of a conversation where involvesStudent is true.
Edits the caller's own message within 15 minutes of sending. In one transaction it inserts a MessageRevision holding the old body, then updates body and editedAt.
endpoints.auth: sender, a participant who has not left, within 15 minutes

endpoints.description: Soft-deletes the caller's own message within 15 minutes by setting deletedAt. No hard delete is possible. The content stays visible to safeguarding leads.
endpoints.auth: sender, a participant who has not left, within 15 minutes

endpoints.description: Reports another participant's message. After commit, every ACTIVE safeguarding lead gets a message.reported notification (mandatory in-app plus email, without the message text) linking to /admin/safeguarding?report=<id>. The client shows the toast 'Reported — the school will review this.'
endpoints.auth: participant who has not left, not the sender
errors: 409 CONFLICT (an OPEN report from this user on this message already exists)

endpoints.description: Returns the number of conversations the caller has not left where lastMessageAt > coalesce(lastReadAt, epoch). It runs as a single $queryRaw COUNT and backs the sidebar badge, which polls every 30 s.
Returns only the users the caller can message (canMessage), in labelled groups. Users the caller cannot message are never returned.
Returns the caller's quiet hours. Both values are null when none are set.
Upserts the caller's quiet hours as HH:mm in the school timezone. The range may wrap midnight. quietStart and quietEnd must be both set or both null (null clears them), and start must not equal end.
errors: 400 VALIDATION_ERROR (only one value set, bad format, or start == end)

endpoints.description: The reports queue, with OPEN reports first and then by createdAt desc. The optional status filter narrows the list.
endpoints.auth: ADMIN with isSafeguardingLead (read from the database)

endpoints.description: Report detail: the reported message, the 5 messages before and the 5 after it (including deleted content and revisions), and the participants. Each call writes audit('safeguarding.conversation.view', entityType 'Conversation').

Marks a report reviewed or dismissed. A review requires a note; for a dismissal the note is optional. Sets status, reviewedById, reviewedAt and reviewNote, and writes audit('safeguarding.report.review' or 'safeguarding.report.dismiss').
Searches conversations where involvesStudent is true. Filters: a participant, and a createdAt or lastMessageAt range. Ordered by lastMessageAt desc.

body.data: { id, subject, participants: UserSummary[], createdAt, lastMessageAt, messageCount, openReportCount }[]

endpoints.description: Read-only view of the full thread, including deleted content (marked as deleted) and the original text of edited messages. Every call writes audit('safeguarding.conversation.view').
errors: 404 NOT_FOUND (also returned when involvesStudent is false)

endpoints.description: EXISTING endpoint, extended with an optional isSafeguardingLead flag. Setting it to true on a non-ADMIN user is rejected. The change is audited in the existing user.update metadata. There is no admin form, so the API and the seed are the only way to set it (ADR-11).

EXISTING maintenance endpoint. Its request and response contract does not change. It also runs processPendingMessageEmails(now) in its own try/catch, processing at most 200 due rows per run. A user who has read, muted or left the conversation is dropped, a user in quiet hours is deferred to the end of quiet hours, and everyone else is sent the email with notify({inApp:false}).

body.data: existing summary + messageEmails: { sent: number, deferred: number, dropped: number }

unchangedButAffected.note: Adds registerFileAccess('message'). Participants who have not left and safeguarding leads are allowed; everyone else is denied. No contract change.
Accepts context 'message' (unattached until sent). No other contract change.
